content:
**Deathjaw** is a type of fish in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Gone Fission* update. 

An uncommon fish that can be caught with Bait - Common, Bait - Improved and Bait - Superb. When eaten, it gives two Rads and restores a total of 20 Hit Points over 25 seconds. It can alternatively be sold, displayed on a Curved Fish Display or Fish Display Plaque, or cooked into Fish Bits.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Deathjaw (1) | | **Built or Scrapped:** | | Fish Bits (5) | 

Can be found at any fishing spot in the Ash Heap.

Ricky claims to have been jumped by four Deathjaws in the past. [1] 

1. ↑ Courier: *"Deadeye, huh? How did you get that nickname?"*
 Ricky:*"Uh, how you think? I shoot things in the eye, that's how good I am! Yeah, I'm that good! Why, uh, once I got jumped by three... Deathjaws! Except actually it was four of them! Imagine that! But I didn't panic, because... because I never panic! What I did was become a storm of death! Shot every one of them monsters "pop" in the eye!"*
 Courier:*"Deathjaws, huh? Did you mean to say "Deathclaws?""*
 Ricky:*"[SUCCEEDED] No, no, you heard me right. "Deathjaws!" They're like Deathclaws - but bigger teeth!"*
(Ricky's dialogue)
